evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution.
